As a result, a bill BILL_A with points_redeemed=1650 whose redemption is covered by a separate non-voided redeem ledger row (bill_number=BILL_B, same customer+amount) STILL appears in the /audit sample and in bills_missing_redeem_ledger. The /fix (used to actually backfill) correctly excludes it, so no double-backfill occurs — but the AUDIT panel/report will over-count. Fix: after the exact-bill unmatched list is computed at lines 2045-2046 of master_brain_tools.py, apply the same customer+amount multiset fallback that _scan_missing_live_redemptions uses (lines 2529-2553) before returning `missing`.
